svg.title: A rescued passenger enters an ambulance as diverted vehicles turn towards the crowded market.
svg.desc: From above, the cycle van blocks the flooded official lane while ambulance crew transfer a rescued bus passenger who is struggling to breathe. The ambulance and other vehicles curve onto a dry side road, where a blank route display directs the whole stream towards the already dense awnings of Twelve-Hand Market.
svg.text: Page 43, panel 6 · High oblique view of stopped traffic and the route network

text.tspan: The respiratory patient is loaded into the ambulance
as the optimiser keeps the flooded road officially
open and diverts all traffic towards the market.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
